scope: Read-only analysis of two already-completed live baseline turns; no new supplier calls, no env/key reads, no runtime/config/code changes.

sources.browser: paid-evidence/box-base-r2.log exact trace IDs; first_text_ms and paint_ms only
sources.pipeline: docker logs oc-v5-u765, 2026-10-18T11:54:10Z..11:55:35Z, exact trace IDs and four existing turn_pipeline_timing stage fields only
sources.master: /var/log/openclaude-v5-selfhost.log exact trace IDs and inbound-turn-start timestamp only
sources.native_decision: /var/log/openclaude-v5-selfhost-egress.log exact request IDs; box_native_decision timestamp and allowlisted enums only
sources.database: openclaude_v5_selfhost local postgres read-only SELECT; exact user_id and request/trace IDs; selected numeric/timestamp/ID fields only
sources.process_first_seen: paid-evidence/billing-agent-box-profile-observer-r2.jsonl filtered against audited request-to-pid mapping; observation is not spawn time
sources.gate_timestamp_semantics: live modelAuthorityGate.ts captures now at enforceModelAuthority entry and stores a.now as turnLeaseVerifiedAtMs after successful verification (lines365,652)
sources.tup_semantics: live http/proxy/core.ts:289,552-567; fetchStart to first nonempty SSE byte; Box injected fetch includes resolver/native decision/staging/launch. observed_at is async SQL NOW in ws/turnPerformance.ts:311
sources.first_visible_semantics: ws/turnPerformance.ts:250-255 records asynchronous SQL NOW, not the actual first-text frame timestamp

interpretation.dominant_observed_cold_vs_followup_chang: context_ready to journal-created drops from 14.712346s to 0.260759s; the pre-authority-gate portion is 13.998s vs0.109s. This is a composite before-gate interval, not a proven CLI-only or provider-only duration.
interpretation.native_reuse: First request native miss/no_candidate; second native resume/ok. Audited native session reused while per-round terminal CLI pids differ; this proves transcript/native-session reuse, not one resident CLI process.

limitations: No unpublished Step1 timing code was treated as live. Existing common stage logs have only the four trace-linked stages above.
The pre-authority-gate interval combines local prompt/MCP/CLI preparation, request emission/transport and early proxy identity/body handling; exact individual durations are unavailable.
The post-gate/pre-journal interval combines fenced auth/catalog, pricing, precheck, upstream preparation, dispatch lookup and journal admission; no individual live stage times exist.

Box native-decision to first text combines remaining native preflight/admission, remote staging/launch, native CLI/provider generation, polling/decoding and delivery; these cannot be separated from existing exact-ID logs.
TUP first byte is not first text and, for Box, is not pure supplier-network TTFT. Do not add its duration as a non-overlapping phase to the anchored wall intervals.
TUP observed_at is asynchronous DB insert time; observed_at minus stream_ms is not used to invent fetch-start or first-text timestamps.

first_visible_at is an asynchronous DB write anchor and may include DB scheduling/retry delay. Wall intervals ending there are approximate persistence-boundary intervals, not exact server first-text execution phases.

Browser and server latency differences include differing starts plus transport/scheduling and are not isolated network latency. Paint is the existing baseline probe, not an independent physical-paint proof.
Native transcript row timestamps occur after already-observed streaming text and are not used as first-text boundaries.
Process observer timestamps prove a process existed by that observation, not its exact spawn/ready time.
Two turns have different histories/output lengths and are not a controlled causal performance experiment.
